newsitem.title: UK: Applied Distribution will not pay final div.
newsitem.headline: Applied Distribution will not pay final div.

text.p: Applied Distribution Group Plc said on Thursday that it has decided not to recommend any final dividend payment.
It said that its trading performance has deteriorated and that it will trade at break-even in the second half.

"In view of these revised expectations for 1996 the board considers that it would be prudent to rebase dividends in line with the anticipated lower level of sustainable profitability," said the company in a statement.
At 0854 GMT, the company's shares were off 29p or 46.4 per cent, at 33 pence.
